CVE-2026-114618.title: Authlib: Default JWT bearer grant accepts assertions for the wrong audience
CVE-2026-114618.description: Authlib is a Python library which builds OAuth and OpenID Connect servers. Prior to 1.9.0, the default RFC 7523 JWTBearerGrant.get_audiences() returns an empty list, causing JWTBearerGrant.verify_claims() to require only that an aud claim exists without matching the current authorization server. An attacker holding a legitimate assertion for another service can present it to a server that shares the signing key and uses the default grant, obtaining an access token across a trust boundary. Implementations that override get_audiences() with the server's valid audience identifiers are not affected. This issue is fixed in version 1.9.0.

CVE-2026-115921.title: ONNX: Null Pointer Dereference in ScanInferenceFunction Due to Missing Required Attribute
CVE-2026-115921.description: Open Neural Network Exchange (ONNX) is an open standard for machine learning interoperability. From 1.4.0 until 1.22.0, ScanInferenceFunction, ScanInferenceFunction_opset8, and ScanInferenceFunction_opset9 do not safely validate the required num_scan_inputs attribute. A missing attribute is dereferenced as a null pointer, while a negative value is converted to size_t and can reach an exceptional oversized allocation path. An untrusted model can therefore terminate or disrupt shape inference, including a negative-value model that can pass onnx.checker.check_model(). This issue is fixed in version 1.22.0.

CVE-2026-14765.title: Epic Games Unreal Engine Insecure Default URL Scheme Allowance in LaunchURL
CVE-2026-14765.description: Epic Games Unreal Engine versions up to and including 5.8.0 ship with an insecure default configuration for the LaunchURL Blueprint node (UKismetSystemLibrary::LaunchURL). The URL scheme filter (FURLRequestFilter) is empty by default, which permits all URL schemes. On Windows, this results in a call to ShellExecuteW() with the open verb, so a supplied file:/// URI causes the referenced file to be executed. Any Unreal Engine game that loads user-generated content containing Blueprints is vulnerable to command execution via a malicious local file or a remote file on a WebDAV share. This is an instance of CWE-1188 (Initialization of a Resource with an Insecure Default).

CVE-2026-58497.title: Uni-CLI: Legacy HTTP MCP transport accepted browser-originated localhost requests
CVE-2026-58497.description: Uni-CLI gives people and agents one command interface for websites, browsers, desktop applications, local tools, and MCP. Prior to version 0.225.2, Uni-CLI exposed the legacy JSON-RPC-over-HTTP MCP transport on loopback without validating browser Origin headers before routing requests. A malicious web page could send a CORS simple POST request, such as text/plain, to the local /mcp endpoint and deliver a JSON-RPC body to the dispatcher. If the user had started the local MCP HTTP transport, that page could drive tools/call requests against the user's local Uni-CLI server. The Streamable HTTP transport already enforced this browser-to-localhost boundary. The legacy stateless HTTP path did not, so the two HTTP transports had drifted. This issue is about the browser-to-localhost boundary; it does not change Uni-CLI's local-code-execution trust model. This issue has been patched in version 0.225.2.

The authorization middleware of the WMS MobileServer
fails to require authentication in two distinct cases. First, it
only requires an Authorization header for GET and HEAD requests; requests
using any other HTTP method are processed without an authentication check.
Second, for any HTTP method including GET and HEAD, a request carrying a
malformed or non-bearer Authorization header is passed through without
a valid token being required.

The middleware does validate a token whenever a
well-formed one is present, but in these two cases it does not
require one. A remote attacker with network access to the service can
therefore invoke API functionality without valid credentials.
